The doctors and nurses are all incredibly kind. I am so grateful for the thorough examination and careful explanations they provided for my precious family member.

I also appreciate that they always say things like, "You were so well-behaved," or "You did so well," when we leave.
I always feel at ease because they examine me thoroughly. They also answer my questions and concerns carefully.

My cat accidentally ingested something, so I had to rush her in for an emergency examination. Despite the short notice, the doctor was very kind and thorough, which put my mind at ease. Thank you very much.

This is a trustworthy hospital because they always provide very thorough examinations and explanations.

They patiently answer any questions, from how to administer medication at home to what to feed my dog.

The nurses are also very gentle and kind with dogs, which puts me at ease. Even my timid dog stays calm during examinations.

I had an appointment, but I waited for an hour. I waited so long I thought they might have skipped my turn. I think it would be helpful if the registration form at the reception desk indicated which department the patient was seeing. I also think it's a problem that some people don't write down their appointment time.
